CustomField.description: Written by: the create leg. The artifact the name was spoken in. THE SECOND ADMISSIBLE EXISTENCE PROOF (wiring proposal v3, section 4): a mention's proof of existence is that somebody said the name, verbatim-anchored, which is the same evidence class everything else in this system stands on. Admissible ALONGSIDE AAO_Participant__c rather than instead of it, so an attendee with no Contact and a person merely named both have a lawful row without either fabricating the other's proof. Restrict on delete for the same reason the participation lookup restricts: the evidence that this person exists at all must not vanish under the row that rests on it.
